     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneAbelInverse
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffFaithfullyFlatDescent
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# The canonical rank-one evaluation divisor
    12	
    13	The noetherian-free canonical divisor theorem is initially stated on affine test algebras.  This
    14	module performs the family-level integration that the Abel inverse needs: it glues those affine
    15	choices over an arbitrary test scheme using separatedness and arbitrary-test uniqueness, transports
    16	the resulting section through the divisor representer, and extends it to the big site.
    17	
    18	No field-fibre dimension assertion is used here.  The only input is the lambda-tied
    19	`PicRankOneOpen` membership contract, so the resulting `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData` is a
    20	genuine family-level datum.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    39	
    40	noncomputable section
    41	
    42	/-! ## The arbitrary-test canonical section -/
    43	
    44	private theorem canonicalRankOneSection_compat {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    45	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) T)
    46	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
    47	    ∀ (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1),
    48	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h)
    49	          (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    50	            (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
    51	            (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
    52	              (Over.fromSpecAffine T V).op hlam))
    53	        = canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    54	            (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
    55	            (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
    56	              (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hlam) := by
    57	  intro U V h
    58	  let fU : overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1) ⟶ T := Over.fromSpecAffine T U
    59	  let fV : overSpec k Γ(T.left, V.1) ⟶ T := Over.fromSpecAffine T V
    60	  let r : Γ(T.left, V.1) →ₐ[k] Γ(T.left, U.1) := Over.resAlgHom T h
    61	  let lamU : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) :=
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map fU.op lam
    63	  let lamV : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k Γ(T.left, V.1)) :=
    64	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map fV.op lam
    65	  have hlamU : lamU ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
    66	      (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))) :=
    67	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C) fU.op hlam
    68	  have hlamV : lamV ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
    69	      (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, V.1))) :=
    70	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C) fV.op hlam
    71	  have hclass : lamU.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap r) lamV.1 := by
    72	    change picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam.1 =
    73	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap (Over.resAlgHom T h))
    74	        (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T V) lam.1)
    75	    rw [← picEtMap_comp]
    76	    exact congrArg (fun q => picEtMap C q lam.1)
    77	      (Over.fromSpecAffine_resAlgHom h).symm
    78	  have habel : abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1)
    79	      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom r
    80	        (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    81	          (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV)) =
    82	      picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1) lamU.1 := by
    83	    calc
    84	      abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1)
    85	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom r
    86	            (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    87	              (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV))
    88	          = PicEtAff.mapAlg C r
    89	              (abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, V.1)
    90	                (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
    91	                  (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV)) :=
    92	            (abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom r _).symm
    93	      _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C r
    94	          (picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, V.1) lamV.1) := by
    95	            rw [canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_abel
    96	              (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV]
    97	      _ = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
    98	          (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap r) lamV.1) :=
    99	            (picEtAffineEquiv_naturality C r lamV.1).symm
   100	      _ = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1) lamU.1 := by rw [hclass]
   101	  exact canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_unique (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   102	    (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamU
   103	    (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom r
   104	      (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   105	        (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) hlamV)) habel

   107	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneSection {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   108	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) T)
   109	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   110	    divFamZarAff C (genus C) T :=
   111	  ⟨fun U => canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   112	      (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   113	      (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
   114	        (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hlam),
   115	    canonicalRankOneSection_compat lam hlam⟩

   117	private theorem picEtAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine
   118	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (s : picEt C T) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
   119	    picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   120	        (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s) = s.1 U := by
   121	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_apply, picEtMap_val,
   122	    picEtMapVal_eq_mapAlg C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s
   123	      (top_le_preimage_fromSpecAffine T U)]
   124	  set psi := Over.appLEAlgHom (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) U.1
   125	    (overSpecTopAffine Γ(T.left, U.1)).1
   126	      (top_le_preimage_fromSpecAffine T U) with hpsi
   127	  set e := (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k Γ(T.left, U.1)).toAlgHom with he
   128	  have hcomp : e.comp psi = AlgHom.id k Γ(T.left, U.1) := by
   129	    rw [he, hpsi]
   130	    exact fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom T U

   133	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C (e.comp psi) (s.1 U) :=

   138	theorem canonicalRankOneSection_abel {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   139	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) T)
   140	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   141	    abelDivAff' C (genus C) T (canonicalRankOneSection lam hlam) = lam.1 := by
   142	  refine picEt.ext fun U => ?_
   143	  rw [abelDivAff'_val, canonicalRankOneSection]
   144	  calc
   145	    abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   146	        (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
   147	          (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   148	          (picRankOneOpen_map_mem (divRepAffP1Map C)
   149	            (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hlam))

   151	            ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
   152	              (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op lam).1 :=
   153	          canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_abel
   154	            (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) _
   155	    _ = lam.1.1 U := picEtAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine T lam.1 U

   157	theorem canonicalRankOneSection_layer {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   158	    (lam : (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   159	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
   160	        (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2) = lam.1 := by
   161	  apply Subtype.ext
   162	  exact canonicalRankOneSection_abel lam.1 lam.2
   163	
   164	theorem canonicalRankOneSection_naturality {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   165	    (f : T' ⟶ T)
   166	    (lam : (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T)) :
   167	    divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) f (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2) =
   168	      canonicalRankOneSection
   169	        (((PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor.map f.op lam).1)
   170	        (((PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor.map f.op lam).2) := by
   171	  let lam' := (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor.map f.op lam
   172	  let s := divFamZarAff.map C (genus C) f (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2)
   173	  let s' := canonicalRankOneSection lam'.1 lam'.2
   174	  have habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) T' s =
   175	      abelDivAff' C (genus C) T' s' := by
   176	    calc
   177	      abelDivAff' C (genus C) T' s =
   178	          picEtMap C f (abelDivAff' C (genus C) T
   179	            (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2)) :=
   180	        (picEtMap_abelDivAff' f (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2)).symm
   181	      _ = picEtMap C f lam.1.1 := by rw [canonicalRankOneSection_abel lam.1 lam.2]
   182	      _ = lam'.1.1 := rfl
   183	      _ = abelDivAff' C (genus C) T' s' :=
   184	        (canonicalRankOneSection_abel lam'.1 lam'.2).symm
   185	  have hclass : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T') s = lam'.1 := by
   186	    apply Subtype.ext
   187	    exact habel.trans (canonicalRankOneSection_abel lam'.1 lam'.2)
   188	  have hmem : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T') s ∈
   189	      (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op T') := by
   190	    rw [hclass]
   191	    exact lam'.2
   192	  exact divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne (divRepAffP1Map C) T' s s' hmem habel
   193	
   194	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneSectionTrans :
   195	    (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor ⟶
   196	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor where
   197	  app T := TypeCat.ofHom fun lam =>
   198	    ⟨canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2, by
   199	      change (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   200	        (canonicalRankOneSection lam.1 lam.2) ∈
   201	          (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj T
   202	      rw [canonicalRankOneSection_layer]
   203	      exact lam.2⟩
   204	  naturality T T' f := by
   205	    ext lam
   206	    apply Subtype.ext
   207	    exact (canonicalRankOneSection_naturality f.unop lam).symm
   208	
   209	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneRepresenterTrans :
   210	    (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor ⟶
   211	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor where
   212	  app T := TypeCat.ofHom fun lam =>
   213	    ⟨(divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.app T
   214	        ((canonicalRankOneSectionTrans (C := C)).app T lam).1, by
   215	      change (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app T
   216	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.app T
   217	            ((canonicalRankOneSectionTrans (C := C)).app T lam).1) ∈
   218	        (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj T
   219	      rw [(divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   220	      exact ((canonicalRankOneSectionTrans (C := C)).app T lam).2⟩
   221	  naturality T T' f := by
   222	    ext lam
   223	    apply Subtype.ext
   224	    symm
   225	    change (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).map f
   226	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.app T
   227	          ((canonicalRankOneSectionTrans (C := C)).app T lam).1) =
   228	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.app T'
   229	        ((canonicalRankOneSectionTrans (C := C)).app T'
   230	          ((PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).toFunctor.map f lam)).1
   231	    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
   232	      ← (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.naturality]
   233	    exact congrArg
   234	      (fun s => (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.app T' s)
   235	      (canonicalRankOneSection_naturality f.unop lam)

   237	theorem canonicalRankOneRepresenterTrans_abel
   238	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   239	    (lam : (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj T) :
   240	    (rankOneAbelRepresented (divRepAffP1Map C)).app T
   241	        ((canonicalRankOneRepresenterTrans (C := C)).app T lam) = lam := by
   242	  apply Subtype.ext
   243	  change (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   244	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app T
   245	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv.app T
   246	          ((canonicalRankOneSectionTrans (C := C)).app T lam).1)) = lam.1
   247	  rw [(divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   248	  exact canonicalRankOneSection_layer lam

   252	  divisor := Over.sigmaExtensionNat (canonicalRankOneRepresenterTrans (C := C))

     9	/-!
    10	# The canonical rank-one divisor, Noetherian-free
    11	
    12	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem` removes the Noetherian hypothesis from the canonical
    13	rank-one divisor: over any affine test `A` whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus there
    14	is a unique widened locally certified divisor class of degree `genus C` with Abel value the
    15	input class — with no Noetherian hypothesis on any presentation carrier.  The price is the
    16	structural hypothesis `hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom` tying the finite chart to the
    17	curve, which feeds the finite-stage rigid engine.
    18	
    19	Membership tested at the identity yields a presentation `P` of the input class on an étale
    20	carrier `B := P.cover.Carrier`, arbitrary and in general not Noetherian.  The Noetherian
    21	input of the glued-divisor keystone is manufactured by descent:
    22	
    23	* the presented datum descends to a finitely generated — hence Noetherian — stage `A₀` with
    24	  pair-`H¹` vanishing at the stage itself (`exists_fg_subalgebra_baseChange_eq` +
    25	  `exists_fg_pairH1_vanishing_stage`);
    26	* stage `H⁰` is finite projective (`datumRigidEngine`), so its `rankAtStalk` is locally
    27	  constant; the rank-one level set of the stage is clopen, contains the image of
    28	  `Spec B → Spec A₀` (rank one over `B` by the presentation), and that image is dense
    29	  because `A₀ ⊆ B` is injective — hence the stage rank is one at every prime;
    30	* rank one at a stage prime gives `h⁰ = 1` on the residue fibre, and the χ-formula
    31	  `h⁰ = deg + (1 − genus)` (`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi`), solved backwards, pins
    32	  the fibre degree of the stage class at `genus C`; the degree law extends to every field
    33	  point of the stage through the kernel-prime residue embedding
    34	  (`Ideal.ResidueField.liftₐ` + `classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition`);
    35	* the keystone `exists_glued_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre` now fires at the Noetherian
    36	  stage; the resulting family pushes up to `B`, its Abel value is the restricted input
    37	  class, and `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness` with the discharged
    38	  uniqueness interface descends it uniquely to `A`.
    39	
    40	The unique class is extracted as `canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem`, with its Abel equation
    41	and uniqueness accessors.
    42	-/
    43	
    44	set_option autoImplicit false
    45	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    46	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
    47	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
    48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    49	
    50	universe u
    51	
    52	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    53	  Opposite TopologicalSpace
    54	open scoped TensorProduct
    55	
    56	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    57	
    58	open AlgebraicJacobian
    59	
    60	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    61	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    62	
    63	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    64	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    65	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    66	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    67	
    68	noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalOverCleft :
    69	    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    70	
    71	/-! ## The Noetherian-free canonical divisor -/
    72	
    73	/-- **The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one class, Noetherian-free**: over any
    74	affine test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus there is a unique widened locally
    75	certified divisor class of degree `genus C` whose Abel value is the input class.  No
    76	Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on any carrier; the finite-chart normalization `hpi`
    77	replaces it, feeding the finite-stage descent of the presented datum. -/
    78	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem
    79	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    80	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    81	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    82	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A))) :
    83	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
    84	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
    85	  classical
    86	  -- membership tested at the identity yields a presentation of the input class
    87	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mp hlam A (𝟙 (overSpec k A))
    88	  have e : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map
    89	      (𝟙 (overSpec k A)).op lam).1 = lam.1 :=
    90	    picEtMap_id C lam.1
    91	  obtain ⟨F, habel⟩ := P.exists_carrier_divFamZarAff_abel hpi
    92	  have habel' : abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F =
    93	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    94	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :=
    95	    habel.trans (congrArg
    96	      (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k))
    97	      (congrArg (picEtAffineEquiv C A) e))
    98	  -- Descend along the etale carrier via the discharged uniqueness interface.
    99	  exact existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness pi
   100	    (rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi) lam hlam P.cover F habel'
   101	
   102	/-! ## Extraction: the canonical divisor and its accessors -/
   103	
   104	/-- **The canonical rank-one divisor of a membership certificate**: the unique widened
   105	divisor class over the test algebra whose Abel value is the rank-one plus class, chosen
   106	from `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem`.  No Noetherian hypothesis. -/
   107	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem
   108	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   109	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   110	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   111	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A))) :
   112	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=
   113	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem pi hpi hlam).choose
   114	
   115	/-- The canonical rank-one divisor satisfies the Abel equation: its widened Abel value is
   116	the input rank-one plus class. -/
   117	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_abel
   118	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   119	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   120	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   121	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A))) :
   122	    abelDivAffPlus C A (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem pi hpi hlam)
   123	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
   124	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem pi hpi hlam).choose_spec.1
   125	
   126	/-- Any Abel-correct widened divisor class equals the canonical rank-one divisor. -/
   127	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem_unique
   128	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   129	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   130	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   131	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   132	    (F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C))
   133	    (hF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :
   134	    F = canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem pi hpi hlam :=
   135	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem pi hpi hlam).choose_spec.2 F hF
   136	
   137	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# Affine evaluation-divisor coherence for the FibrePresented producer
    10	
    11	The arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` producer needs a divisor cut by the
    12	canonical evaluation section which is stable under restriction of affine test schemes.  This
    13	file records two construction-level inputs for that gluing step:
    14	
    15	* `datumSectionBaseChange_tower` proves that the tied datum section itself is coherent along
    16	  every affine coefficient tower;
    17	* `baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq` proves independence of the chosen rank-one generator after
    18	  passing to a pairwise product open.
    19	
    20	The remaining gluing edge is deliberately explicit: one must identify `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` of
    21	the local divisor with the divisor cut by the tower-transported section.  No
    22	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` or pullback-square hypothesis is introduced here.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	open scoped TensorProduct
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	
    38	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    39	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    40	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    41	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    42	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    43	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    44	
    45	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    46	
    47	/-- The actual section attached to a tied presentation is transitive under arbitrary affine
    48	coefficient extension.  The cast is along the canonical equality between iterated and direct
    49	base change of the same cocycle datum. -/
    50	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_tower
    51	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    52	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    53	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    54	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B']
    55	    [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    56	    [IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier B B']
    57	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    58	    let hD : (P.datum.baseChange B).baseChange B' = P.datum.baseChange B' :=
    59	      P.datum.baseChange_baseChange C P.cover.Carrier B B'
    60	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' pi =>
    61	      ↑(gluedSubmodule B' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
    62	        ((P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop B'
    63	          (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y)) =
    64	      P.datumSectionBaseChange B' y := by
    65	  rw [P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B y,
    66	    P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B' y]
    67	  exact P.datum.sectionsMapTop_tower
    68	    C P.cover.Carrier B B' (P.datumSection y)
    69	
    70	/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(f)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
    71	theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_left
    72	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    73	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    74	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    75	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    76	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    77	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    78	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    79	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    80	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    81	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    82	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
    83	  intro p hfg
    84	  exact hy p fun hf => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_right g hf)
    85	
    86	/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(g)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
    87	theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_right
    88	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    89	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    90	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    91	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    92	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    93	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    94	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    95	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    96	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    97	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    98	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
    99	  intro p hfg
   100	  exact hy p fun hg => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_left f hg)
   101	
   102	/-- Local evaluation divisors cut by two rank-one generators agree on the direct pairwise
   103	product open.  This is the generator-independence half of the compatibility premise required
   104	by `divFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
   105	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq
   106	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   107	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   108	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
   109	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   110	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   111	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   112	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   113	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   114	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
   115	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   116	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   117	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   118	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y
   119	        (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_left f g y hy) =
   120	      P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y'
   121	        (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_right f g y' hy') :=
   122	  P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_eq (f * g) y y'
   123	    (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_left f g y hy)
   124	    (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_right f g y' hy')
   125	
   126	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation

   128	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    12	
    13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    17	
    18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    42	
    43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    46	def PicRankOneOpen :
    47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    55	      apply Subtype.ext
    56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    57	    rw [e]
    58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    59	
    60	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    61	
    62	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    63	
    64	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    65	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    66	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    67	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    68	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    69	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    70	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    71	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    72	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    73	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    74	
    75	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    76	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    77	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    78	contract. -/
    79	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    80	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    81	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    82	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    83	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    84	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    85	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    86	  rfl
    87	
    88	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    89	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    90	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    91	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    92	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    93	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    94	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    95	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    96	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    97	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    98	
    99	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
   100	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   101	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   102	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   103	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   104	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   105	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   106	
   107	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   108	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   109	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   110	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   111	
   112	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   113	
   114	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   115	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   116	relative-open gate below. -/
   117	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   118	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   119	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   120	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   121	
   122	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   123	
   124	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   125	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   126	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   127	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   128	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   129	
   130	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   131	
   132	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   133	
   134	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   135	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   136	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   137	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   138	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   139	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   140	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   141	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   142	  W : X.Opens
   143	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   144	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   145	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   146	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   147	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   148	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   149	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   150	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   151	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   152	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   153	
   154	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   155	
   156	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   157	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   158	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   159	
   160	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   161	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   162	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   163	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   164	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   165	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   166	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   167	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   168	      φ.app S) D.sq
   169	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   170	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   171	  · intro v w hvw
   172	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   173	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   174	
   175	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   176	
   177	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   178	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   179	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   180	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   181	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   182	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   183	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   184	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   185	  intro X g
   186	  let d := D X g
   187	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   188	
   189	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   190	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   191	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   192	  h
   193	
   194	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   195	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   196	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   197	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   198	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   199	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   200	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   201	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   202	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   203	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   204	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   205	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   206	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   207	
   208	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   209	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   210	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   211	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   212	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   213	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   214	
   215	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   216	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   217	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   218	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   219	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   220	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   221	
   222	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   223	
   224	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   225	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   226	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   227	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   228	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   229	
   230	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   231	representer. -/
   232	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   233	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   234	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   235	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   236	
   237	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   238	def rankOneAbelAff :
   239	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   240	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   241	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   242	
   243	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   244	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   245	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   246	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   247	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   248	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   249	
   250	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   251	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   252	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   253	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   254	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   255	
   256	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   257	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   258	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   259	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   260	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   261	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   262	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   263	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
   264	
   265	end
   266	
   267	end AlgebraicGeometry

     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Assembly from a rank-one divisor-fibre pullback
    10	
    11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
    12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
    13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
    14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
    15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
    16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    17	
    18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
    19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
    20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
    21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
    22	
    23	Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
    24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    33	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    48	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    49	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
    50	
    51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    53	
    54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
    55	abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    56	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor
    58	
    59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
    60	def rankOneAbelSigma :
    61	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    62	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
    63	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)
    64	
    65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
    67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
    68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    69	
    70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    71	
    72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
    73	
    74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
    75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
    76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
    77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
    79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
    80	
    81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
    82	
    83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
    84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
    86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
    87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
    88	
    89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
    90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
    92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
    93	
    94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
    95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/

    12	This is the single, self-contained **statement file** of the project: it collects every

    19	must not weaken or restate any signature below.

    21	By a **smooth curve** we mean a geometrically irreducible, smooth scheme of relative dimension one
    22	over a field, proper over that field.

   197	instance {k L M : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M]

   199	    IsProper ((baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C).hom :=
   200	  inferInstanceAs (IsProper ((baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom)
   201	instance {k L M : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M]
   202	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   203	    GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C).hom :=
   204	  inferInstanceAs (GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom)
   205	instance {k L M : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M]
   206	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] :
   207	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C).hom :=
   208	  inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom)
   209	
   210	/-- Base change along `k → k` is the identity functor. -/
   211	noncomputable def baseChange.idIso (k : Type u) [Field k] :
   212	    baseChange k k ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
   213	  eqToIso (by
   214	    change Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) = Over.pullback (𝟙 _)
   215	    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]) ≪≫ Over.pullbackId
   216	
   217	/-- Base change along a tower `k → L → M` is the composite of the two base changes. -/
   218	noncomputable def baseChange.compIso (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
   219	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M] :
   220	    baseChange k M ≅ baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M :=
   221	  eqToIso (by
   222	    change Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k M))) =
   223	      Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L M)) ≫
   224	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))
   225	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]) ≪≫
   226	    Over.pullbackComp _ _
   227	
   228	namespace Jacobian
   229	
   230	/-- The Jacobian respects isomorphisms of curves — *derived* from the bundled functor
   231	`Jacobian.functor` via `Functor.mapIso`, not a primitive. Used to compare the two sides of the
   232	cocycle, whose curves agree only up to `baseChange.compIso`. -/
   233	noncomputable def congr {k : Type u} [Field k] {C C' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   234	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   235	    [IsProper C'.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C'.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C'.hom]
   236	    (e : C ≅ C') :
   237	    (.mk (Jacobian C) : Grp (Over (Spec (.of k)))) ≅ .mk (Jacobian C') :=
   238	  let j : (⟨C⟩ : Curve k) ≅ ⟨C'⟩ :=
   239	    { hom := e.hom, inv := e.inv, hom_inv_id := e.hom_inv_id, inv_hom_id := e.inv_hom_id }
   240	  (Jacobian.functor k).mapIso j.symm.op
   241	
   242	/-- **The base-change condition.** Jacobians commute with base change of fields: a canonical
   243	isomorphism `Jac(C)_L ≅ Jac(C_L)`, as group schemes over `L`. -/
   244	noncomputable def baseChangeIso (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   245	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   246	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   247	    (baseChange k L).mapGrp.obj (.mk (Jacobian C)) ≅ .mk (Jacobian ((baseChange k L).obj C)) :=
   248	  sorry
   249	
   250	/-! ## Functoriality: the base change isomorphisms form a coherent system. -/
   251	
   252	/-- Identity coherence. -/
   253	theorem baseChangeIso_id (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   254	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   255	    baseChangeIso k k C =
   256	      (Functor.mapGrpNatIso (baseChange.idIso k)).app _
   257	        ≪≫ (Functor.mapGrpIdIso (C := Over (Spec (.of k)))).app _
   258	        ≪≫ Jacobian.congr ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).symm :=
   259	  sorry
   260	
   261	/-- Cocycle coherence for a tower `k → L → M`. -/
   262	theorem baseChangeIso_comp (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
   263	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]
   264	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   265	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   266	    baseChangeIso k M C
   267	        ≪≫ Jacobian.congr ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C) =
   268	      (Functor.mapGrpNatIso (baseChange.compIso k L M)).app _
   269	        ≪≫ (Functor.mapGrpCompIso (F := baseChange k L) (G := baseChange L M)).app _
   270	        ≪≫ (baseChange L M).mapGrp.mapIso (baseChangeIso k L C)
   271	        ≪≫ baseChangeIso L M ((baseChange k L).obj C) :=
   272	  sorry
   273	
   274	/-! ## Compatibility with the Abel-Jacobi map -/
   275	
   276	variable {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   277	
   278	theorem baseChange_ofCurve (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   279	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   280	    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :

Read both PDFs fully. No files or Horizon state changed.

The binding critical path is:

`Div^g` representer -> `DivRankOneOpen` -> `rankOneAbelIso` -> translated cover over `k^s` -> `pic0_sepClosed_representableBy` -> `representableBy_of_finiteGalois_baseChange` -> `pic0_representableBy` -> `jacobianData`. (Plan pp. 2-4, 17-18; supervision p. 2)

The immediate gate is not a fieldwise rank calculation. It is one arbitrary-affine, family-level producer:

- For every affine test family in the intended locus, construct actual `PicRankOneNativePresentation` / `FibrePresented` data.
- Prove cartesian pushforward/base-change comparison maps are `IsIso`.
- Tie `H1 = 0`, `H0` finite-projective locally free of rank one, and the native presentation to the same family, coherently under every affine pullback.
- Consume this package in the public `PicRankOneOpen` / `DivRankOneOpen` interfaces and the canonical inverse. (Supervision p. 4)

The canonical inverse must be built on arbitrary test schemes from the evaluation map `f^*(f_* L) -> L`, giving its zero divisor; it must not choose a generator. It must prove degree `g`, arbitrary base-change compatibility, and equality of Picard class modulo pullback, then establish both inverse identities and `rankOneAbelIso`. (Plan p. 8)

Explicit anti-shortcut rules:

- Fieldwise `h0 = 1` and `H1 = 0` do not establish a natural arbitrary-test inverse.
- Do not make the desired property a hypothesis, use an unrelated existential witness/carrier, or add a wrapper with no consumer.
- No generator-selection construction.
- High-degree Abel is infrastructure/fallback only; its positive-dimensional fibres prevent the desired chart in positive genus. Reopen quotient only with a full non-circular quotient contract. (Plan pp. 3-4, 7-9, 14, 16-17; supervision pp. 3-5)

Required named declarations/files:

- `Picard/Pic0CriticalPath.lean`: imports/checks all endpoint declarations. (Plan p. 5)
- `Picard/Pic0EndgameContract.lean`: `PicRankOneOpen`, `DivRankOneOpen`, `rankOneAbel`, `divisorOfRankOne`, `rankOneAbelIso`, translated-cover theorem, both Pic0 producers. (Plan p. 6)
- `Curve/RelativeCurveBridge.lean`: canonical `relCurve C L` spelling, transports/instances/base-change simp bridges. (Plan p. 7)
- `rankOneAbel_isOpenImmersion`
- `exists_translation_mem_picRankOneOpen`
- `pic0_sepClosed_representableBy`
- `representableBy_of_finiteGalois_baseChange`
- `pic0_representableBy`
- `jacobianData`. (Plan pp. 8-12, 15, 17-18)

Subsequent gates:

1. Translation theorem over separably closed base: for every extension and input `lam`, return a base-field `L0` whose translation is in `PicRankOneOpen`; witness must be explicitly tied to `lam`. (Plan p. 9)
2. Open-cover criterion yields `pic0_sepClosed_representableBy`; this is the first headline milestone. (Plan p. 10)
3. Reuse/import AJC finite-Galois quotient/gluing stack. Descent must return both a scheme and its `RepresentableBy` certificate, then be consumed immediately by `pic0_representableBy`; do not duplicate descent in AJCR. (Plan pp. 10-11)
4. Build every `JacobianData` structure from the same pinned `pic0_representableBy`, not independently chosen representation data. (Plan p. 11)

Endpoint credit/acceptance requires narrow critical-root import and build, immediate downstream consumption, relevant module kernel build, recorded `#print axioms`, obsolete route deletion/specialization, full-project build, and only `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` in final axiom output. (Plan pp. 4-5, 14-15)

The supervision memo is point-in-time as of Aug. 7 (p. 7), but its binding diagnosis is clear: Phase 3/5 were genuinely blocked by this same arbitrary-affine producer; Phase 4 should own integration, while translated-cover feeder work stays parked until it can enter the real public interface. (Supervision pp. 1-5)

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocalDivisor
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Affine evaluation-divisor coherence for the FibrePresented producer
    10	
    11	The arbitrary-scheme `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` producer needs a divisor cut by the
    12	canonical evaluation section which is stable under restriction of affine test schemes.  This
    13	file records two construction-level inputs for that gluing step:
    14	
    15	* `datumSectionBaseChange_tower` proves that the tied datum section itself is coherent along
    16	  every affine coefficient tower;
    17	* `baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq` proves independence of the chosen rank-one generator after
    18	  passing to a pairwise product open.
    19	
    20	The remaining gluing edge is deliberately explicit: one must identify `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` of
    21	the local divisor with the divisor cut by the tower-transported section.  No
    22	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` or pullback-square hypothesis is introduced here.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	open scoped TensorProduct
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	
    38	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    39	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    40	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    41	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    42	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    43	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    44	
    45	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    46	
    47	/-- The actual section attached to a tied presentation is transitive under arbitrary affine
    48	coefficient extension.  The cast is along the canonical equality between iterated and direct
    49	base change of the same cocycle datum. -/
    50	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_tower
    51	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    52	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    53	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
    54	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B']
    55	    [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    56	    [IsScalarTower P.cover.Carrier B B']
    57	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    58	    let hD : (P.datum.baseChange B).baseChange B' = P.datum.baseChange B' :=
    59	      P.datum.baseChange_baseChange C P.cover.Carrier B B'
    60	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B' pi =>
    61	      ↑(gluedSubmodule B' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
    62	        ((P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop B'
    63	          (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y)) =
    64	      P.datumSectionBaseChange B' y := by
    65	  rw [P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B y,
    66	    P.datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul B' y]
    67	  exact P.datum.sectionsMapTop_tower
    68	    C P.cover.Carrier B B' (P.datumSection y)
    69	
    70	/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(f)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
    71	theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_left
    72	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    73	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    74	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    75	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    76	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    77	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    78	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    79	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    80	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    81	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    82	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
    83	  intro p hfg
    84	  exact hy p fun hf => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_right g hf)
    85	
    86	/-- A generator which is fibrewise nonzero on `D(g)` remains so on `D(f * g)`. -/
    87	theorem generator_nonzero_on_mul_right
    88	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    89	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
    90	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    91	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    92	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    93	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    94	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
    95	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f * g ∉ p.asIdeal →
    96	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    97	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    98	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0 := by
    99	  intro p hfg
   100	  exact hy p fun hg => hfg (p.asIdeal.mul_mem_left f hg)
   101	
   102	/-- Local evaluation divisors cut by two rank-one generators agree on the direct pairwise
   103	product open.  This is the generator-independence half of the compatibility premise required
   104	by `divFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
   105	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_mul_eq
   106	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   107	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   108	    (f g : P.cover.Carrier)
   109	    (y y' : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   110	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   111	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   112	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   113	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   114	    (hy' : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, g ∉ p.asIdeal →
   115	      (y' ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   116	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   117	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   118	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y
   119	        (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_left f g y hy) =
   120	      P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f * g) y'
   121	        (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_right f g y' hy') :=
   122	  P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_eq (f * g) y y'
   123	    (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_left f g y hy)
   124	    (P.generator_nonzero_on_mul_right f g y' hy')
   125	
   126	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   127	
   128	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducerAwayNaturality
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffZariskiSep
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CechKernelLemma
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Finite gluing of the rank-one evaluation divisor on a presentation carrier
    12	
    13	Over the Noetherian affine carrier of a tied rank-one presentation, the local evaluation
    14	divisors produced on a finite spanning family of principal opens are compatible on pairwise
    15	overlaps.  They therefore glue to an actual `DivFamZarAff` on the carrier.  Zariski separation
    16	of `PicEtAff` identifies the Abel value of the glue with the represented input class, and
    17	injectivity of the etale-plus unit identifies its relative Picard class with the presentation
    18	representative.  The chosen local sections retain their exact Cech-class and native evaluation
    19	identities.
    20	
    21	This is deliberately only a Noetherian, presentation-carrier result.  It does **not** descend
    22	the glued divisor through the etale cover to the original algebra `A`, does not prove
    23	independence of the chosen presentation, does not construct an arbitrary-scheme pullback
    24	square, and does not produce `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    29	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    34	open scoped TensorProduct
    35	
    36	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    45	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    46	
    47	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    48	
    49	set_option maxHeartbeats 3200000 in
    50	/-- The finite principal-open evaluation divisors of a tied rank-one presentation glue on its
    51	Noetherian etale carrier.  The result records the global Abel and relative-Picard identities,
    52	while retaining the exact local Cech-class and evaluation identities of the chosen sections.
    53	
    54	The divisor `F0` lives over `P.cover.Carrier`; this theorem neither descends it to `A` nor
    55	constructs `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`. -/
    56	theorem exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    57	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    58	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
    59	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → P.cover.Carrier)
    60	      (y : Fin m → Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    61	      (hy : ∀ (i : Fin m) (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier),
    62	        f i ∉ q.asIdeal →
    63	          (y i ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    64	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    65	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    66	      (F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)),
    67	      Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧
    68	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    69	          DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    70	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    71	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0 =
    72	            P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)) ∧
    73	        abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
    74	          PicEtAff.mapAlg C
    75	            ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    76	            (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) ∧
    77	        relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
    78	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) ∧
    79	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    80	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    81	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    82	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0).picClass =
    83	            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away (f i))).cechPicClass) ∧
    84	        ∀ i : Fin m,
    85	          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
    86	            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    87	              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
    88	            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 (y i)) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 (y i) := by
    89	  classical
    90	  obtain ⟨m, f, hspan, hgood⟩ :=
    91	    P.exists_fin_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    92	  choose y hy habel hclass heval using hgood
    93	  let F : ∀ i : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f i)) (genus C) :=
    94	    fun i => P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)
    95	  have hcompat : ∀ i j : Fin m,
    96	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f i j) (F i) =
    97	        DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f i j) (F j) := by
    98	    intro i j
    99	    exact P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat
   100	      (f i) (f j) (y i) (y j) (hy i) (hy j)
   101	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ :=
   102	    DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
   103	  have habel0 : abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
   104	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   105	        ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   106	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
   107	    refine PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq C
   108	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
   109	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down)) ?_ (fun l => ?_)
   110	    · rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
   111	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
   112	      exact hspan
   113	    · let i := l.down
   114	      change PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   115	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   116	            (Localization.Away (f i)))
   117	          (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) = _
   118	      calc
   119	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   120	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   121	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   122	            (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) =

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite gluing of the rank-one evaluation divisor on a presentation carrier
    12	
    13	Over the Noetherian affine carrier of a tied rank-one presentation, the local evaluation
    14	divisors produced on a finite spanning family of principal opens are compatible on pairwise
    15	overlaps.  They therefore glue to an actual `DivFamZarAff` on the carrier.  Zariski separation
    16	of `PicEtAff` identifies the Abel value of the glue with the represented input class, and
    17	injectivity of the etale-plus unit identifies its relative Picard class with the presentation
    18	representative.  The chosen local sections retain their exact Cech-class and native evaluation
    19	identities.
    20	
    21	This is deliberately only a Noetherian, presentation-carrier result.  It does **not** descend
    22	the glued divisor through the etale cover to the original algebra `A`, does not prove
    23	independence of the chosen presentation, does not construct an arbitrary-scheme pullback
    24	square, and does not produce `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.

    92	  choose y hy habel hclass heval using hgood

   109	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down)) ?_ (fun l => ?_)

   111	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
   112	      exact hspan
   113	    · let i := l.down
   114	      change PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   115	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   116	            (Localization.Away (f i)))
   117	          (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) = _
   118	      calc
   119	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   120	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   121	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   122	            (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) =
   123	            abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))
   124	              (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   125	                (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   126	                  (Localization.Away (f i))) F0) :=
   127	          abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom
   128	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   129	              (Localization.Away (f i))) F0
   130	        _ = abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i)) (F i) :=
   131	          congrArg (abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))) (hF0 i)
   132	        _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   133	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   134	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   135	            (PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   136	              ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   137	              (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   138	          have hphi :
   139	              (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i))).restrictScalars k =
   140	                IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i)) :=
   141	            AlgHom.ext (fun _ => rfl)
   142	          rw [← hphi]
   143	          simpa only [F] using habel i
   144	  have htarget :
   145	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   146	          ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   147	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) =
   148	        PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier

    14	module: the certificate and the native presentation are both attached to the displayed cocycle

    46	
    47	The equalities `hrep` and `hclass` tie the datum to the requested lambda class.  All four
    48	cohomological fields are projected from `cert`, whose modules are definitionally the H-modules

    50	pushforward comparison is intentionally an explicit argument until its protected producer lands.
    51	-/

    53	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
    54	    (x : descentClasses C E)
    55	    (hrep : PicEtAff.mk C E x = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)
    56	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C E.Carrier pi)
    57	    (hclass :
    58	      (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) =
    59	        relPicMk C (overSpec k E.Carrier) D.cechPicClass)
    60	    (hpush :
    61	      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    62	        (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    63	        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C E.Carrier)
    64	        (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    65	          (relCurve C E.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of E.Carrier)) g),

    67	    (cert : RankOneFamilyCertificates D) :
    68	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    69	  { cover := E
    70	    representative := x
    71	    represents := hrep
    72	    datum := D
    73	    datum_class := hclass
    74	    native_pushforward_base_change := hpush

    76	    h0_finite := cert.h0_finite
    77	    h0_projective := cert.h0_projective
    78	    h0_rank_one := cert.h0_rank_one }

    12	/-!
    13	# Native rank-one certificates for the lambda-tied datum
    14	
    15	This file closes the Picard-side consumer boundary.  A `PicRankOneNativeDatum` already records
    16	that its etale representative presents the displayed lambda and that its basic-open cocycle datum
    17	represents that same relative Picard class.  Residue-field split witnesses therefore produce the
    18	four cohomological certificates for this exact datum over its arbitrary affine coefficient ring.
    19	
    20	The returned package uses the canonical `h0BaseChange` and `scalarExtension` operations from
    21	`RankOneFamilyCertificates`; `h0BaseChange_tower` proves their coherence along every affine
    22	coefficient tower.  The final constructor passes the package directly to
    23	`PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    43	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    44	variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    45	
    46	namespace PicRankOneNativeDatum
    47	
    48	/-- The pointwise split condition on the displayed lambda representative carried by `P`. -/
    49	abbrev ResidueSplitWitnesses (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam) : Prop :=
    50	  ∀ t : (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier).left,
    51	    IsSplitWitness C
    52	      (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
    53	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
    54	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))))
    55	
    56	/-- Produce the complete arbitrary-affine certificate package for the lambda-tied datum `P`.
    57	
    58	The H1 input is converted from split witnesses for `P.representative`; the degree law is derived
    59	from `P.represents` and `P.datum_class`.  Finiteness and projectivity are constructed at a genuine
    60	finite Noetherian stage and transported back, rather than supplied by the caller. -/
    61	noncomputable def familyCertificates
    62	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    63	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    64	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses) :
    65	    RankOneFamilyCertificates P.datum :=
    66	  RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi
    67	    (P.residueH1Witness_of_isSplitWitness hsplit)
    68	    (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L)
    69	
    70	/-- Canonically extend the lambda-tied certificate package to any affine coefficient algebra. -/
    71	noncomputable def familyCertificatesBaseChange
    72	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    73	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    74	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    75	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
    76	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
    77	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (P.datum.baseChange B) :=
    78	  (P.familyCertificates hpi hsplit).scalarExtension B
    79	
    80	end PicRankOneNativeDatum
    81	
    82	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    83	
    84	/-- Assemble a native rank-one presentation from the actual lambda-tied datum and its split
    85	witnesses.  The only remaining independent input is the native pushforward base-change theorem. -/
    86	noncomputable def ofNativeDatum
    87	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    88	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    89	    (hsplit : P.ResidueSplitWitnesses)
    90	    (hpush :
    91	      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    92	        (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    93	        (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
    94	        (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    95	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g),
    96	        IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.datum.nativeModule)) :
    97	    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
    98	  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificates
    99	    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class hpush

   102	end PicRankOneNativePresentation

    12	/-!
    13	# Native presentations for split field classes
    14	
    15	A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
    16	cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
    17	the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.
    18	
    19	A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
    20	so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.
    21	
    22	The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
    23	`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
    24	-/

    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28

    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    32	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    37	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

    44	
    45	/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.
    46	
    47	Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
    48	field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
    49	arbitrary affine scheme. -/
    50	theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
    51	    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
    52	    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
    53	    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
    54	  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
    55	  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
    56	  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
    57	  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
    58	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    59	    apply Spec.map_injective
    60	    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
    61	    exact hw
    62	  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
    63	    { __ := psi.hom
    64	      commutes' := fun r ↦
    65	        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
    66	  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    67	  ext : 1
    68	  exact hmap.symm

    73	two class equalities stored in `P`; finiteness, projectivity, and rank one follow from the
    74	arbitrary-ring certificate theorem; and native pushforward base change is the canonical
    75	all-cartesian theorem.  Thus every field concerns the same cocycle datum. -/
    76	noncomputable def PicRankOneNativeDatum.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness
    77	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    78	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    79	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    80	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    81	    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    82	    (hres : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
    83	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :

    87	      (RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi hres
    88	        (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L))
